dsh-plugin-gate is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4c7346aa31f21ec1c7d2.html
